supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Extends moderately beyond the lateral orbital margins as a contiguous ridge.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: The muzzle region exhibits significantly higher pixel intensity (lighter) relative to the darker, low-intensity periocular and cheek regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Lower lip displays moderate vertical thickness with a slight structural droop away from the maxillary line.

other_distinctive_markers: An elongated, light-colored object (potential plant material or tool) is protruding from the mouth.
